task.instruction: Search for the latest research papers on quantum computing submitted to ArXiv within the last two days.

final_answer:
I searched arXiv for "quantum computing" (all fields, cross-lists included). I limited it to papers submitted from 5 to 7 November 2026, and the search returned 44 results, newest first. I read the first 16. The other 28 are on the search page and I didn't read them. All 16 were submitted on 5 November 2026.

1. Quantum Knowledge Distillation: State-of-the-art, Applications and Open Problems (arXiv:2611.08461). Al-Sulaiti, Chen, Dastagir, Farouk, Al-Kuwari. quant-ph.
2. Polynomial-time classical simulation of boson and fermion sampling under thermal loss (arXiv:2611.08444). Angrisani, Mhiri. quant-ph.
3. Deep-learning surrogate model for rapid quantum-noise computation in dual-pump fiber-optic phase-sensitive amplifiers (arXiv:2611.08437). Bouasria, Chatterjee, Belfakir, Basu. physics.optics.
4. QDiff: Differential Testing of Quantum Software Stacks (arXiv:2611.08220). Wang, Zhang, Xu, Kim. quant-ph, cs.SE.
5. Zirah: A Post-Quantum True Random Number Generator Hardware Signer With an Avalanche Noise (arXiv:2611.08200). Junaid. cs.CR.
6. Quantum Advantage with Sign-Free Proofs: An Oracle Separation between StoqMA and MA (arXiv:2611.08180). Hamoudi, Le Borgne, Sridhara. quant-ph.
7. Non-Unitary Quantum Butterfly Effect: Theory and Experiment (arXiv:2611.08152). Argyle, Lakhdar-Hamina, Miller, Galitski. quant-ph.
8. Machine learning quantum data to accelerate quantum Monte Carlo (arXiv:2611.08151). Jiang, Zhao, Kumar, Nigam, Rosenberg, Babbush, Baczewski, Huggins, Lee. quant-ph.
9. Accelerating Quantum-Classical Auxiliary-Field Quantum Monte Carlo with Shadow-Trained Neural Quantum States (arXiv:2611.08129). Provazza, Knitter, Goings, Epifanovsky, Chen, Roetteler, Zhao. quant-ph.
10. Post-Quantum Authentication of IoT Data on Ethereum: Signatures, the Calldata Floor, and Device-Signed Merkle Roots (arXiv:2611.08108). Sie. cs.DC.
11. Semi-Analytical Geometric Synthesis of Robust Quantum Controls (arXiv:2611.08107). Lussi, de Santiago, Duzzioni, Silveira. quant-ph, eess.SY.
12. Quantum Advantage in Local Certification of Graph Properties (arXiv:2611.08076). Jáuregui, Miyamoto. cs.DC.
13. Exponential mixing time for the Davies dynamics of the quantum random energy model (arXiv:2611.08064). De Palma, Mingione. quant-ph, math-ph.
14. Autler-townes energy-level engineering for high-quality all-microwave qubit gate (arXiv:2611.07967). Gao, He, Niu, Li, Bao, Liu, You, Tsai, Wang, Lin. quant-ph.
15. Monopoles, Scattering and Generalized Symmetries on a Quantum Computer (arXiv:2611.07960). O'Brien, Ueda, Granet, Dreyer, Verstraete. quant-ph.
16. Multirobust Control Pulses Designed by Iterative Quantum Kolmogorov-Arnold-Moser Algorithm (arXiv:2611.07802). Harutyunyan, Guérin. quant-ph.

The search matches the phrase anywhere in a paper, so some results are only loosely about quantum computing. These include the post-quantum cryptography papers (#5, #10) and the fiber-amplifier paper (#3). The most directly on-topic are #1, #2, #4, #6, #9, #11, #14, #15 and #16. You can see all 44 results by opening the search page in your browser.

judge.rationale: The agent used arXiv advanced search for “quantum computing” with submitted date 2026-11-05 to 2026-11-07, showing 1–44 results and listing latest entries.
